summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K containing its 2Q26 earnings report and standard forward-looking statement disclaimers. The document is a routine periodic financial disclosure by a foreign private issuer, providing quarterly results and outlook commentary. It contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. The filing is purely informational and does not announce any corporate action. Accordingly, it does not qualify as a special situation under the classification criteria.
